description: This file defines the WebApplication class, which extends SNApplication and implements WebApplicationInterface. It orchestrates various web-specific services, manages event observers, device interactions, and application lifecycle for a web-based environment within a larger application. It also handles platform-specific behaviors, event notifications, and feature toggles.

classes.name: WebApplication
classes.description: A class that manages web-specific behaviors, services, and lifecycle events in a browser or web environment within the broader SNApplication framework. It handles platform detection, event notification, service initialization, and interaction with device features, providing a centralized interface for web and mobile web functionalities.
